headlines.shortLinkText: Knueppel breaks rookie 3-point season record in Hornets' romp over Pacers

headlines.description: — Tyrese Maxey broke Allen Iverson's 76ers franchise record for 3-pointers, finishing with five 3s and 28 points Thursday night in Philadelphia's 124-117 victory over the Miami Heat.
headlines.shortLinkText: Tyrese Maxey breaks 76ers record for 3-pointers as Philadelphia beats Miami Heat 124-117

headlines.description: — Atlanta newcomers CJ McCollum and Corey Kispert combined for 58 points against their former team on Thursday night, leading the Hawks to a 126-96 win against the Washington Wizards.
headlines.shortLinkText: McCollum and Kispert combine for 58 points against former team in Hawks' 126-96 win vs Wizards

events.name: San Antonio Spurs at Brooklyn Nets

headlines.description: — Julian Champagnie scored 26 points to lead the San Antonio Spurs to their 11th straight victory, 126-110 over the Brooklyn Nets on Thursday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Julian Champagnie scores 26 and Spurs cruise to 11th straight win, 126-110 over Nets

headlines.description: — Kevin Durant scored 26 of his season-high 40 points in the second half and the Houston Rockets wiped out a 19-point Orlando lead in less than four minutes to beat the Magic 113-108 on Thursday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Kevin Durant scores season-high 40 as Rockets rally for 113-108 win over Magic

events.name: Portland Trail Blazers at Chicago Bulls

headlines.description: — Jerami Grant scored 27 points and the Portland Trail Blazers held on for a 121-112 victory over Chicago on Thursday night, sending the Bulls to their 11th straight loss.
headlines.shortLinkText: Grant’s 27 points lift Trail Blazers past Bulls 121-112 as Chicago’s skid hits 11

headlines.description: — Precious Achiuwa had a career-high 29 points and added 12 rebounds, Maxime Raynaud scored 22 points and the Sacramento Kings beat the Dallas Mavericks 130-121 on Thursday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Achiuwa has career-high 29 points to lead the Kings past the Mavericks, 130-121

events.name: Los Angeles Lakers at Phoenix Suns

headlines.description: — Royce O'Neale made a 3-pointer with 0.9 seconds remaining, Grayson Allen scored 28 points and the short-handed Phoenix Suns beat the Los Angeles Lakers 113-110 on Thursday night after blowing a late 12-point lead.
headlines.shortLinkText: Royce O'Neale hits last-second 3 to lift short-handed Suns over Lakers, 113-110

events.name: New Orleans Pelicans at Utah Jazz

headlines.description: — Saddiq Bey scored 42 points, Zion Williamson had 20 and the New Orleans Pelicans beat the Utah Jazz 129-118 on Thursday night to open a two-game set.
headlines.shortLinkText: Bey scores 42 points, Pelicans beat Jazz 129-118 to open 2-game set in Utah

headlines.description: — Anthony Edwards scored 31 points, Donte DiVincenzo added 18 and the surging Minnesota Timberwolves beat Los Angeles Clippers 94-88 on Thursday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Anthony Edwards, Timberwolves outlast short-handed Clippers 94-88
